title: Threats on Mount Rushmore in the security briefing
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mount Rushmore, South Dakota

tellings.quote: You know, there were threats on Mount Rushmore and they wanted to detonate a site

plain: In 1977, an Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says a security briefing at Ellsworth, an Air Force base in South Dakota, warned of threats against Mount Rushmore, with people who "wanted to detonate a site". Woods, who says he was among airmen taken by aliens, tells Michels this from his own time at the base as part of the background to that night.
